_comment: Copy to .cursor/mcp.json (project) or merge into Cursor User MCP. task-registry and metric-registry are team-required; feishu-im is outbound notify (roster only). headroom is optional local mount. Default headroom args = MCP-only (no proxy). For MCP+Proxy, append: --proxy-url http://127.0.0.1:8787 (or wrap-cursor path like http://127.0.0.1:8787/p/<user>). If headroom not on PATH, use absolute path from where.exe headroom / which headroom.
